function: Optional independently stateful Engram limbs with bounded sequential or parallel host work.
capabilities: Per-limb identity and canonical Journal memory
Durable intentions, bounded workers and reviewed crash recovery
adaptation: Compatibility is determined by interface and recipe acceptance tests; this label is advisory.
verified_with: tests/test_limbs.py and the separately recorded Studio qualification; experimental until executed evidence is complete.
provenance: New shared implementation; owner requested optional limb composition during Anchor Studio development.

usage.use_when: A recipe explicitly needs independently stateful limbs; omit for ordinary single-agent operation.
inputs: Owner-selected Engrams, reviewed handlers and grants, recipe obligations
outputs: Canonical per-limb receipts and coordinator task state
usage.limits: 0..32 registered limbs, 0..8 workers, 128 pending tasks. No model client, no OS sandbox, and no exactly-once external effect guarantee.
